is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports the Vgsc-1014F (L995F) marker (page 7, 10, 11).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports the frequency of the Vgsc-1014F mutation (13% to 36%) for specific time points (August 2008 and May 2009) (page 7, 11).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Mali (Thierola, Niono, Bagadaji, Kolimana) (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original research article (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides specific village names and coordinates (e.g., Thierola [13.6586°N, 7.2147°W]) (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers collections from 2008 to 2011 (Table 2, page 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary study reporting new genetic data for these specific samples.

supplement.evidence: The required data (marker frequencies) are provided in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the population genetics of Anopheles coluzzii in the Sahel to test the aestivation hypothesis. It reports the frequency of the Vgsc-1014F resistance marker in field-collected samples from Mali.
